summary: Audited inventory for T1 item 1 (Design sources): 5 xschem schematics and 5 derived netlists, regeneration gate 'python3 design/netlist.py --check'. Every member file is listed with its sha256 and signoff/check.py re-derives the inventory from the live tree, so the bound hash proves the inventory is current and the member hashes prove the files it describes are. It does not run a simulation or re-derive any measured value.
